summary: OpenAI announced that Samsung Electronics is deploying ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to its employees in Korea and worldwide across its Device eXperience division.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement states rapid growth in Codex weekly active users alongside a large-scale enterprise-wide rollout, indicating rising aggregate inference volume.
mechanisms.quote: More than 5 million people now use Codex every week for technical and non-technical workflows and roles.
